description: Derive and return a digest-only external evidence link between an existing AIPOU workReceiptId and an opaque Paybox operation artifact. It is a pure local calculation: it does not persist the link, call Paybox, unlock a wallet, create a payment, sign a transaction, or change AIPOU claim eligibility. Use it for portable correlation only, and verify both artifacts with their native systems before relying on the returned link.

issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 time at which this correlation artifact is issued.

payboxOperationDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the Paybox operation artifact bytes.

payboxOperationId.description: Opaque Paybox operation reference. Never send a credential, wallet address, payment token, or secret.

name: create_paybox_work_link
